bootstrap: paired over patients, stratified by study so a resample cannot consist mostly of one trial
exploratory_not_in_the_family: agreement between derived RECIST progression and CA031's investigator-assessed PROGDAY - a validation of the pipeline, not a test of the hypothesis

cytostatic (A6181087, erlotinib) versus cytotoxic (CA031, carboplatin/paclitaxel) - CONFOUNDED WITH STUDY, since line of therapy, era, population and scan schedule differ too; named here so that finding it later cannot be called a discovery
known_limitations_stated_in_advance: two studies is not a cross-validation; leave-one-study-out is a two-way swap and cannot separate study from anything correlated with study
the landmark requires surviving and being assessed twice, so both cohorts are enriched for slower progressors and their event rates are not their trials'
single-arm comparator data in both, so no within-patient treatment comparison exists and the PDX selection endpoint has no human analogue
scan schedules differ (8 weeks against 6), so the pre-landmark window spans different real time in the two studies even though the rule is identical
the single-study result was null on its primary; the pooled analysis is better powered but is not independent of it
landmark_rule: the second scheduled tumour assessment, per protocol
multiplicity: Holm across the primary and the five secondary analyses
outcome_harmonisation: CA031's investigator-assessed PROGDAY is NOT used in the pooled primary, because A6181087 has no equivalent and mixing them would make the studies non-comparable
primary_metric: Harrell C-index for time to progression
primary_outcome: RECIST progression derived from the SLD panel: sum >= 120% of the post-landmark reference AND >= 5 mm absolute, or a new lesion; computed by the same function in both studies
question: Pooled across NSCLC comparator arms, does the SHAPE of the pre-landmark tumour-burden trajectory predict time to RECIST progression better than depth of response alone?
secondary_analyses: leave-one-study-out: fit on one study, evaluate on the other
per-study C-index, reported separately and not pooled
SLD-source events only, new lesions censored
primary model plus log baseline SLD as a prognostic adjustment

sld_source.A6181087: sum of per-lesion TMMDIA over baseline target lesions
sld_source.CA031: SUMDIAM, which the CRF already sums per assessment; one row per patient per CPEVENT, since the ten-slot form repeats the same sum on every lesion row

studies_excluded.EFC10261: SDTM release contains no TR or TU domain, so no per-lesion measurements exist; excluded on data structure, before any outcome was computed

success_rule: pooled trajectory C-index exceeds pooled comparator C-index with a 95% paired bootstrap interval, clustered on study, excluding zero

time_axis.CA031: SCANDAY - RANDDAY where present (about 35% of rows), else the nominal week parsed from CPEVENT x 7; the two agree to within two days at every scheduled visit

unit_harmonisation: CA031 records diameters in CENTIMETRES (SUMDIAM range 0-70); A6181087 in MILLIMETRES. CA031 is converted to mm on load, so the 5 mm absolute threshold and the 5 mm too-small floor mean the same thing in both
validation: 5-fold cross-validation stratified on event status and study, so each fold carries both studies in similar proportion
